full_page.content:
Page 112 Nov. 19 Kathleen Renaud - 30 - compli. - Mary Ann Malszeck - 2 - peculiar asthma and Hay fever
Stephen Basco - 57 - asks for prayer for daughter and family. Married out of the Church to one without faith - has four beauti- ful children but sadly neglected in religious training - Husband was a Lutheran.
Mrs. Lucy Kerwin - 51 - ostamalitis feared. Very unusual case. Had three ribs removed in Feb. 1937. The ribs grew back again. Drs. astonished. Has not been well lately ... enrolled perpetually. John Farmer - 50 - serious cancerous condition - has not been cath- olic but learning to say the rosary.
Patricia Beal - 9 - serious Ear Helena McClarty = 80 - Hemoraged last Sunday - serious arthritis Charles Smith - 83 - very sick -- Thomas Waldron - 14 - fears operation.
Page 113 Nov. Dr. M. D. Klote - 41 - very active was out riding in horse and buggy last March. Horse ran away ... Dr. lost one leg below knee and the other broken in hip - refuses to knit ... Enrolled Today.
John Sak - 22 - Norfold, V. spinal maningitis - prayed for last week .... hopeful.
25 George Maierle - 72 - in dying condition - away from sacraments for many yrs. till To-day. Daughter asks for prayers lest he be not in earnest as he ought to be . Enrolled him 2.
26 Mrs. Ruth Brook - 41 - "of the church of Christ" - asks for prayers that her husband come to himself again .... and forget divorce.
Mary Alice Kenny - 60 - inward cancer - very threatening.
29 Mrs. Rose Miller - 50 - and husband Ferc. - 59 - She was threatened with removal of breast two months ago. Has bad high blood-pressure. Thank God both are decidedly improving.
